spec.claim_summary: A 1-hour long strategy buys when price crosses above the 20 EMA and the next candle closes above the prior high, with a 2x ATR stop and 1.8R target.
assumptions: Asset mapped from 'Bybit BTC/USDT' to Binance spot symbol BTCUSDT; venue difference ignored.
Timeframe is 1h as stated for the EMA chart.
'Price moves above the 20 EMA' compiled as close crosses_above 20-period EMA; close used for price.
Two-bar sequence encoded on one signal bar: cross evaluated 1 bar ago plus confirmation close above prior high on signal bar.
'Current price' for SL/TP math taken as signal-bar close; ATR taken at signal bar.
TP described as 1.8 x stop distance compiled as take_profit_r 1.8 with 2 x ATR stop, equivalent to 3.6 x ATR.
No indicator exit stated, so exit conditions left empty; position ends on fixed stop/target only.
Claimed backtest start 'since January 2021' normalized to 2021-01-01; end of 'last 2 years' not explicitly dated so period_end left null.

evidence.quote: only works on the Bybit BTC/USDT chart.
on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit
Every time the price moves above the 20 EMA on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit
If the next candle closed above the previous candle's high, you long.
SL will be at the current price - (2 * ATR indicator)
TP will be at the current price + 1.8 * (current price - SL price ).
